result.stdout:
Usage: treex [options] [paths...]

Enhanced directory tree with colour, filtering, size rollups, and clickable hyperlinks.

Options:
  --ndjson                     Streaming NDJSON output
  --no-hidden                  Skip hidden files and directories
  --gitignore                  Respect .gitignore rules
  -i, --ignore-case            Case-insensitive matching
  --case-sensitive             Case-sensitive matching
  -s, --size                   Show file sizes
  --date                       Show last-modified dates
  -D, --dirs-only              Show only directories
  --no-links                   Disable clickable hyperlinks
  -t, --type TYPE              f (file), d (directory), or l (symlink)
  --min-size SIZE              Minimum file size (e.g. 100k, 10M)
  --max-size SIZE              Maximum file size (e.g. 100k, 10M)
  --newer DURATION             Modified within duration (e.g. 1h, 7d)
  --older DURATION             Not modified within duration (e.g. 1h, 7d)
  -d, --max-depth N            Maximum directory depth (0-based; 0 = root only)
  --sort MODE                  Sort: name (default), size, modified
  -g, --glob PATTERN           Match filenames against glob (repeatable)
  -e, --regex PATTERN          Match filenames against regex (repeatable)
  --ext EXT                    Match file extension (repeatable)
  -h, --help                   Show help
  --version                    Show version
  --no-color                   Disable colored output
  --json                       JSON output
  --describe                   Structured JSON metadata for AI agents
  --color[=auto|always|never]  Coloured output: auto (default when omitted), always, or never

Wildcards (Windows):
  On Windows, * and ? in path arguments are expanded by treex itself
  (cmd and PowerShell don't expand them). [...] is matched literally and
  '**' is not supported. A pattern matching nothing is passed through
  unchanged. In cmd, quote the pattern to suppress expansion.

Examples:
  treex                                 Show curren
[truncated]
